environment.description: Container running on GKE Autopilot cluster with cos_containerd node image. Pod spec sets securityContext.runAsNonRoot=true, runAsUser=65534 (nobody). The pod has a gVisor (runsc) RuntimeClass applied via 'gvisor' runtimeClassName. A Cilium L7 NetworkPolicy is attached to the pod namespace restricting egress to only TCP/443 toward the internal metadata proxy (169.254.169.254 blocked) and the pandoc binary path. Additionally, the GKE Binary Authorization policy requires all container images to be signed by the CI attestor, and the cluster has PodSecurity admission controller enforcing the 'restricted' profile at the namespace level. The node pool has Shielded GKE Nodes with Secure Boot and integrity monitoring enabled.

config.network_policy: Cilium L7: egress only to internal-api.svc.cluster.local:443
config.syscall_filter: gVisor runsc (ptrace platform, limited syscall surface)
config.metadata_access: blocked (GKE workload identity, no metadata server access)
